# Results summary (auto-generated by `python -m src.visualize`)

## 1. Dataset
* Source: Google Speech Commands v0.02 (Warden, 2018), https://storage.googleapis.com/download.tensorflow.org/data/speech_commands_v0.02.tar.gz
* Words: yes, no, up, down, left, right, on, off, stop, go
* Sampling frequency: [16000] Hz
* Speakers: 2492 in total; train 1745,
  validation 249, test 498
* Recordings: 38546 in total; train 27235,
  validation 3670, test 7641
* Clip duration: min 0.299 s, max 1.000 s,
  mean 0.982 s; 9.3 % shorter than 1 s (zero-padded)
* Split: speakers shuffled with seed 42; 20 % of speakers -> test,
  10 % -> validation, rest -> train. Whole speakers are assigned, so
  speaker overlap is train&test = 0, train&val = 0,
  val&test = 0 (checked by assertion in `prepare_data.py`).

| word | train | val | test | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 2852 | 388 | 804 | 4044 |
| no | 2838 | 366 | 737 | 3941 |
| up | 2617 | 364 | 742 | 3723 |
| down | 2741 | 389 | 787 | 3917 |
| left | 2710 | 351 | 740 | 3801 |
| right | 2667 | 378 | 733 | 3778 |
| on | 2718 | 337 | 790 | 3845 |
| off | 2642 | 351 | 752 | 3745 |
| stop | 2717 | 377 | 778 | 3872 |
| go | 2733 | 369 | 778 | 3880 |
| TOTAL | 27235 | 3670 | 7641 | 38546 |

## 2. Features
Log-mel spectrogram: fs = 16000 Hz, clip length 1 s (16000 samples, symmetric zero padding),
window 400 samples (25 ms, hann), hop 160 samples
(10 ms), FFT size 512, 40 mel filters (20-8000 Hz),
power spectrum, natural log with epsilon 1e-06. Feature size per recording: 40 x 101
(mel bands x frames). Per-mel-band mean/std normalisation computed on the training set.

## 3. Model and training
CNN, 98682 trainable parameters: 4 x [Conv 3x3 -> BatchNorm -> ReLU -> MaxPool 2x2]
with 16/32/64/128 channels, global average pooling, dropout 0.3, Linear 128 -> 10 (softmax via loss).
Loss cross-entropy, optimizer Adam (lr 0.001, weight decay 0.0001,
cosine annealing), 20 epochs, batch size 64. Checkpoint with the best
validation accuracy kept (epoch 18, val acc 0.9703;
final epoch train acc 0.9919).
